description: Horaires théoriques et temps réel du réseau de transports beeMob (Béziers Méditerranée) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Réseau beeMob - Transports en commun de l'Agglomération Béziers Méditerranée. This dataset offers the theoretical transport offer (lines, stops, timetables) and real time (times of next crossings and geolocation) of the beeMob network. This data is produced by RDBM, public transport public service delegate of the Communauté d'Agglomération Béziers Méditerranée.&x20; The theoretical offer is available in GTFS format ( ). Coverage: Réseau beeMob - Transports en commun de l'Agglomération Béziers Méditerranée. The portal shows the English title as "Theoretical timetables and real time of the beeMob transport network (Mediterranean Beziers)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Réseau beeMob - Transports en commun de l'Agglomération Béziers Méditerranée. Its keywords include mobilite, transport, beemob, bus, beziers. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GTFS-RT, GTFS. The listing shows 2026-04-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
